name: tasks

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.federation.config.mjs

_comment-dependencies: This split is NOT the usual runtime-vs-tooling one, and moving a package across it changes
what the browser runs. @jahia/vite-federation-plugin turns every key of "dependencies" into
a module-federation SHARE (see vite.federation.config.mjs), i.e. a package the app shell is
expected to hand us at runtime; everything else is bundled privately. Every package here is
bundled into dist/ by the SSR/islands build either way, so "dependencies" here means
"provided by the app shell", not "needed at runtime".
@jahia/moonstone and @jahia/moonstone-alpha therefore sit in devDependencies on purpose: the
shell only publishes Moonstone 2.14.2, which exports neither Banner, DataTable nor EmptyData,
so the board cannot use the shell's copy and must bundle its own -- privately, see the crash
described in the fix commit for #61.
_comment-toolchain-pins: vite, @jahia/vite-federation-plugin and the @module-federation/vite resolution below are
pinned to EXACT versions, and they are pinned together: this trio is the toolchain
formidable-engine ships, and it is the only combination proven to bridge Jahia's webpack-5
app shell. Do not float them.
@module-federation/vite <= 1.14 emits share stubs that TOP-LEVEL AWAIT the federation
runtime (`await runtimeInit.then(rt => rt.loadShare('react', ...))`), so nothing touches a
shared module before the host's share scope has actually been bridged. From 1.16 it emits a
SYNCHRONOUS globalThis.__mf_module_cache__ probe instead, which cannot wait for an async
bridge and takes the whole Jahia UI down at boot (see the fix commit for #61).
That rewrite is not gratuitous: rolldown, which is Vite 8's bundler, REFUSES the awaiting
form -- `vite build` fails with [REQUIRE_TLA] because react/cjs/react-jsx-runtime.production
.min.js reaches the stub through a CommonJS require(). So the safe stub requires Vite 7, and
Vite 8 requires the unsafe stub; the two pins are one decision, not two. Revisit only when a
@module-federation/vite release resolves shares asynchronously under rolldown as well.
The pins hold both builds back to Vite 7, the SSR/islands one included; @jahia/vite-plugin
